acceptance_criteria: GAP-PKG-018 adopts the existing VERIFIED AUTH-DB-019 identity_access foundation rather than creating a competing identity schema or duplicating its principal/link objects.

auth.users remains the authentication account source while enterprise identity is represented through identity_access principals and explicit Auth-to-enterprise links; role or site metadata stored in Auth metadata is not treated as enterprise authority.

Worker, client and device identity linkage scenarios are tested with deterministic fixtures, including missing, ambiguous, inactive or conflicting mappings that must resolve explicitly or fail closed.
The existing AUTH-DB-033 AccessContext resolver graph remains compatible with identity_access and no package test may weaken its ownership, privilege or safe-projection guarantees.
Each of the eleven canonical TREQ IDs currently assigned to GAP-PKG-018 has explicit package-specific evidence in the six reserved TP-DB-001 artifacts.

No database schema, hosted Auth configuration, VITAL object, legacy Auth foreign key or production environment is modified by this adoption package unless a later package-gate re-maturation explicitly authorizes a proven delta.
All six package-specific evidence artifacts plus the clean local Supabase replay and canonical npm regression facade pass before physical verification.
Production remains unauthorized; the only remote deployment target declared by the dossier is STAGING project rcrxixmqhrndcervbllp under SUPA-TRANS-015 governance.

rollback_steps: If package-specific evidence materialization fails, revert only the GAP-PKG-018 evidence files created by the authorized implementation instance; do not alter the already VERIFIED AUTH-DB-019 foundation.
If tests prove that identity_access requires a product or schema delta, stop the implementation and re-mature GAP-PKG-018 with the exact new physical target before making that delta.

No database rollback is required for the dossier as currently scoped because the physical product/schema operation is adoption without modification and the confirmed delta is package-specific evidence only.
After any evidence rollback, rerun the existing AUTH-DB-019 and AUTH-DB-033 local database tests to confirm the pre-package physical foundation remains unchanged.
